scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n platform,partner-ops,payments -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:platform:all" "npm run dev:partner-ops" "npm run dev:payments"
scripts.dev:partner-stack: concurrently -n platform,partner-ops -c blue,green "npm run dev:platform:partner" "npm run dev:partner-ops"
scripts.dev:payments-stack: concurrently -n platform,payments -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:platform:payments" "npm run dev:payments"
scripts.dev:platform: cross-env PARTNER_OPS_ENABLED=false PAYMENTS_ENABLED=false npm run dev -w @debtflow/platform
scripts.check: npm run clean && npm run check:architecture && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.check:platform: npm run clean:platform && npm run check:architecture && npm run lint:platform && npm run typecheck:platform && npm run build:platform
scripts.check:partner-ops: npm run clean:partner-ops && npm run check:architecture && npm run lint:partner-ops && npm run typecheck:partner-ops && npm run build:partner-ops
scripts.check:payments: npm run clean:payments && npm run check:architecture && npm run lint:payments && npm run typecheck:payments && npm run build:payments
scripts.check:architecture: npm run check:boundaries && npm run check:manifest
scripts.dev:platform:partner: cross-env PARTNER_OPS_ENABLED=true PARTNER_OPS_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3001 PAYMENTS_ENABLED=false npm run dev -w @debtflow/platform
scripts.dev:platform:payments: cross-env PARTNER_OPS_ENABLED=false PAYMENTS_ENABLED=true PAYMENTS_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3002 npm run dev -w @debtflow/platform
scripts.dev:platform:all: cross-env PARTNER_OPS_ENABLED=true PARTNER_OPS_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3001 PAYMENTS_ENABLED=true PAYMENTS_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3002 npm run dev -w @debtflow/platform
